PatternPad - Create beautiful patterns for presentations, social media or branding.

name: PatternPad
summary: Seamless pattern generator: pick shapes and palettes, tune parameters, and export the pattern as SVG or PNG.
description: Browser editor that generates endless pattern variations from shapes, parameters and hand-picked colour palettes. Patterns export as PNG, JPG or SVG for branding, presentations, social media and product customisation. Free to use; commercial use is allowed with credit and the artwork itself may not be resold.
contains: endless pattern variations from shapes, colours and parameters
commercial use allowed with credit and link to PatternPad
artwork itself may not be resold
